title: Search-based Trace Diagnostic for Cyber-Physical Systems
abstract: arXiv:2406.17268v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Cyber-physical systems (CPS) development requires verifying whether system behaviors violate their requirements. This analysis often considers system behaviors expressed by execution traces and requirements expressed by signal-based temporal properties. When an execution trace violates a requirement, engineers must solve the trace diagnostic problem---they need to understand the cause of the breach. Automated trace diagnostic techniques aim to support engineers in the trace diagnostic activity.   This paper proposes search-based trace diagnostic (SBTD), a novel trace diagnostic technique for CPS requirements. Unlike existing techniques, SBTD relies on evolutionary search. SBTD starts from a set of candidate diagnoses, applies an evolutionary algorithm to generate new candidate diagnoses (via mutation, recombination, and selection), and uses a fitness function to determine the qualities of these solutions. translated_title: 面向信息物理系统的基于搜索的轨迹诊断
translated_abstract: 信息物理系统（CPS）的开发需要验证系统行为是否违反其需求。这种分析通常将系统行为表示为执行轨迹，将需求表示为基于信号的时序属性。当一条执行轨迹违反某项需求时，工程师必须解决轨迹诊断问题——他们需要理解违反需求的原因。自动化轨迹诊断技术旨在支持工程师开展轨迹诊断活动。本文提出了基于搜索的轨迹诊断（SBTD），一种面向CPS需求的新型轨迹诊断技术。与现有技术不同，SBTD依赖于进化搜索。SBTD从一组候选诊断出发，应用进化算法（通过变异、重组和选择）生成新的候选诊断，并使用适应度函数来评估这些解决方案的质量。随后，诊断生成器……
tldr: 本文提出了SBTD，一种利用进化搜索（变异、重组和选择）为信息物理系统的轨迹需求违反自动生成诊断原因的新型轨迹诊断技术。
